task.title: P6-151: Disambiguate ambiguous /my selections instead of refusing them
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, Selection tray and batch move). Original id: P6-151. Size: M. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**Ambiguous `/my` selections are refused rather than disambiguated** (was `P6-063`; **rescoped 2026-07-30** — its "until the removal/teardown task widens the write path" framing is obsolete, that task shipped 2026-07-25 and the `Board` refusal is already gone). What remains: a card in more than one collection, or with copies across several printings, comes back as `ManyCollections` / `ManyPrintings` / `ManyBoards` telling the user to open a collection and select the row there (`move_selection.rs:130-153`). A "which copies?" step in the picker would let the batch complete without leaving the page. Pairs with `P6-047`, which is the other natural place to answer it.
